thesis: Treat the room as a cold cosmic void where isolated beam geometry and restrained cyan-white reveals convert fractured synth texture into spatial depth without warm-color contamination.

artist_branding.summary: Aplexo on the Purified axis suggests melodic depth, polished atmosphere, and emotionally rich but controlled motion where texture and space matter more than blunt FX density.
visual_cues: Cold near-monochrome palette anchored in deep navy and icy cyan
Single-source beam isolation moments that read as stars in an open void
Prism and gobo texture used for fracture detail instead of strobe aggression
do_not_copy: Avoid replicating identifiable label artwork compositions or exact scene choreography from official promo edits.

motifs: Geometry motif: sparse center-to-ceiling routes with periodic wide-orbit expansions
Color motif: deep navy base, icy cyan accents, and cold white reserved for peak clarity
Movement motif: 4-beat drift in intro/breakdown with 2-beat pressure in drop phases

visual_direction.color_story: Keep a strict cool-only progression from near-black navy into cyan and white, with no amber, red, or gold detours.
visual_direction.motion_story: Frame low-energy sections as slow suspended drift, then tighten rhythm and widen coverage as sub energy and density increase.
visual_direction.staging_story: Use Sharpy as the star narrator, keep BSW/Profile as atmospheric support, and let NI3K peak only at late drop climax.

must_include: Zero warm colors across all phrases
At least one extended low-density solo beam moment in breakdown
Prism texture in drop sections to represent fractured synth identity
avoid: Amber, gold, or red accents in any section
Continuous rapid strobing used as a substitute for texture
Overfilling every bar with full-rig intensity in atmospheric passages
